role_summary: FinOps Engineer role focused on cloud financial management, governance, allocation and optimization across multi-cloud infrastructure for a financial-services environment.
responsibility_text: Monitor and optimize cloud costs; develop governance and accountability frameworks; create allocation, chargeback and showback models; produce dashboards, forecasts and budget reports; identify optimization opportunities; partner with Engineering, Finance, Procurement and Business stakeholders.
requirement_text: FinOps Framework; AWS, Azure and OCI cost management; CloudHealth, Apptio Cloudability or Finout; financial reporting and forecasting; Power BI or Tableau; Excel; cloud governance and resource optimization; stakeholder and vendor management.
preferred_text: Financial-services cloud financial operations experience preferred.
